hop_1: FINDING: Odda, also known as Oddune, was a ninth-century ealdorman of Devon, known for his victory at the Battle of Cynwit in 878, where his West Saxon forces defeated a Viking army led by Ubba.

hop_2: FINDING: Ubba was a mid-ninth-century Viking chieftain and one of the commanders of the Great Army.

Final answer: Viking chieftain
